card: Prevents an unhandled std::bad_optional_access exception in loadtxoutset when a snapshot's network magic does not match the node on custom signets. Because custom signet magic is derived from the challenge, GetNetworkForMagic returns an empty optional, causing the error message construction in SnapshotMetadata::Unserialize to throw. The fix provides a fallback name for custom signets so users receive a clear error message instead of an exception.
evidence: PR description: Before: 'Unable to parse metadata: bad_optional_access'; After: 'Unable to parse metadata: The network of the snapshot (main) does not match the network of this node (custom signet).'
PR description: The new unit test `snapshot_metadata_network_mismatch_custom_signet` fails on master with `std::bad_optional_access`.
problem: When running on a custom signet and loading a snapshot from another network via `loadtxoutset`, accessing the empty network name optional throws `bad_optional_access`. Users see an unhandled exception error rather than an informative mismatch error message.

risk.why: A mistake in snapshot metadata error handling could produce incorrect error text or fail to reject invalid snapshots, affecting users loading assumeutxo snapshots.

summary: Fixes an unhandled `std::bad_optional_access` exception when deserializing an assumeutxo snapshot on a custom signet with mismatched network magic. The error-formatting logic in `SnapshotMetadata::Unserialize` now falls back to "custom signet" when `GetNetworkForMagic` returns no value, returning a descriptive error string instead of an exception.
